label: Sasovo
operator_statement: Yandex: 'seriously damaged in a drone attack'; 'completely shut down'; no employees hurt; no restoration timeline
physical_damage: Fire at facility (Meduza). Ryazan authorities: roof of 'one of the enterprises' caught fire, plant not named. Status of supercomputers Chervonenkis and Lyapunov (housed here) not reported
service_effects: Reported problems with Yandex Cloud, Disk, Documents; outages reported on websites of Cian, Russian Railways and several regional administrations. Yandex shares fell >3%
location: Sasovo, Ryazan oblast; part of former Sasta machine-tool plant
facility_notes: Hosts supercomputers Chervonenkis (21.53 PFLOPS, #19 TOP500 Nov 2021) and Lyapunov (12.81 PFLOPS, #40); Yandex Cloud zone ru-central1-b (per SecurityLab citing Yandex Cloud status page)
conflicts: Power figure is a press estimate, not an operator disclosure

label: Kaluga
power: 63 MW design (~58 MW IT; planned PUE 1.07-1.09)
operator_statement: Yandex: 'several modules of the data center have been completely disabled'; 'part of its infrastructure is out of service'; no employees hurt; damage still being assessed
physical_damage: Partial: several modules disabled (total number of modules not given). Kaluga governor: infrastructure damaged
service_effects: Not attributed to this site specifically. Yandex shares fell ~4%
casualties: Governor Shapsha: 9 injured in Kaluga - NOT linked to the data center by officials
area: ~130,000 m2 (as reported by ComNews; unclear if site or floor area)
facility_notes: Yandex's largest data center; 4th Yandex Cloud availability zone
conflicts: Design figures from 2022 announcement; built-out share at time of strike unknown

label: Vladimir
power: 10 MW first phase; 40 MW planned in 4x10 MW phases (2017); ~40 MW (Kommersant 2026); ~56 MW (Militarnyi, unsourced)
operator_statement: Yandex: infrastructure damaged, leading to complete shutdown of the data center; no one injured
physical_damage: Fire on site. RFE/RL satellite imagery (via Militarnyi): 5 of 9 buildings damaged - in one data center block all four buildings hit, in the second a single impact. Galushkin 'likely damaged' per T-invariant (unconfirmed)
service_effects: Vladimir supports Yandex Pay (per Yandex fintech head Pirogov) - Pay offline as of 12 Oct. Cumulative effect of all three Yandex strikes: Yandex Cloud in 'limited mode', NetBlocks ~30% of normal on 11 Oct; Yandex advised customers to move hosting; client sites (Magnit, Vkusno i Tochka, M.Video) affected; disruptions in Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, Yerevan; Kommersant source: replacement equipment could take up to 6 months
casualties: None reported at site. Regional head: ~1,600 customers lost power in Vladimir region - NOT linked to the data center by officials
area: ~6 ha site; 9 buildings on site (RFE/RL imagery via Militarnyi)
facility_notes: Full free cooling (outside air); hosts Galushkin supercomputer; supports Yandex Pay; first phase >2.5 bn RUB
conflicts: Power: 40 MW vs 56 MW - use 40 MW (two sources incl. original plan) unless 56 MW is sourced

label: Balakovo
operator_statement: Sber (Vedyakhin): 'We confirm the attack on the data center'; all systems and services operating normally; no staff hurt; damage not disclosed
physical_damage: Not disclosed. Local social-media photos appear to show a damaged building (unverified). NV: commercial satellite monitoring recorded thermal anomalies at the complex (coordinates not published)
service_effects: Sber says none. Same day, widespread user-reported disruptions (DownDetector, Sboy.rf) at Sber, GigaChat, Samokat and many unrelated providers (Rostelecom, MTS, MegaFon, VK, Gosuslugi, banks) - causal link to Balakovo NOT established. Sber shares -0.7%
casualties: Governor Busargin: 1 civilian killed, several residential buildings damaged by drone debris - NOT linked to the data center site
notes: Missing from OSM datasets - most likely due to being classified as under construction till 2027
location: Balakovo SEZ, Saratov oblast, near Balakovo NPP (SEZ parcel ~53.6 ha)
commissioned: Memorandum 2020; construction 2021; full commissioning planned 2027; some blocks reportedly operating
facility_notes: Intended host for GosTech government platform; dedicated 220 kV substation (2x100 MVA) planned (Suty News)
conflicts: Cost: 30 bn RUB (CNews 2021 estimate) vs 122.2 bn RUB (Ukrinform 2026). All figures are planned full build-out, not current state

label: Novosergievka
power: 20 MW total, 6.5 MW guaranteed: max 5 kW/rack (alldc.ru)
operator_statement: VK: 'A UAV attack was carried out on the VK data center in Leningrad region. VK services are available to users as normal'
physical_damage: Not disclosed; no imagery of the data center itself published yet. Adjacent Vostochnaya 330 kV substation reportedly struck
service_effects: NetBlocks: VK connectivity at 56% of normal; Sboy.rf complaint spike 03:00-05:00 local; users reported site not loading / messages failing, later stabilised. St Petersburg governor warned mobile internet may be disrupted (confounder)
casualties: Governor Drozdenko: 4 injured incl. 3 children from drone debris near Kirovsk and in Vsevolozhsk - NOT linked to the data center. ~20,000 residents lost power after line damage
location: ~2 km from Novosergievka, Zanevskaya volost, Vsevolozhsk district; next to 330 kV Vostochnaya substation
facility_notes: A second VK-linked data center, M100 (operator OOO M100), received a construction permit in Novosergievka in 2025
conflicts: Rack count 160 vs 640 (possible expansion or different counting). Which Novosergievka facility was struck (2011 DC or M100 site) not established
